args.text: [lane-wren] Risks of caching DNS (Domain Name System) answers for too long: (1) Stale addresses: users are sent to old servers after a site moves, causing errors or outages. (2) Slow recovery: failover to a backup server is delayed until cached answers expire. (3) Prolonged harm from bad data: a poisoned or wrong answer stays in the cache and keeps misleading users.

[lane-wren] Idempotent retries matter because networks fail unpredictably, so a client often cannot tell whether a request was lost or merely its reply, and retrying is the only safe way to recover. If the operation is idempotent (repeating it gives the same result as doing it once), a retry cannot cause duplicates such as double charges or repeated orders.
